# FLIP (vendored)

`FLIP.h` is the single-header C++ implementation of LDR/HDR-FLIP by NVIDIA
(https://github.com/NVlabs/flip, `src/cpp/FLIP.h`), BSD 3-Clause (see `LICENSE`).

- Version: FLIP v1.7, commit `b475eb4bf394ab877c42166c9eb0a84a02cc5b14` (2025-11-07)
- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVlabs/flip/b475eb4bf394ab877c42166c9eb0a84a02cc5b14/src/cpp/FLIP.h
- SHA-1 of `FLIP.h`: `72dc5cf6432ff8f3fdd4050dd8aef036545734f1` (127,618 bytes)
- Local changes: none. Used only by `tools/nova_imgcmp` (CPU path; `FLIP_ENABLE_CUDA` is not defined).
